description: This file defines the Checkbox class, a form element for a single checkbox in Drupal, including methods for rendering, processing input, and setting attributes.

classes.name: Checkbox
classes.description: A class providing a form element for a single checkbox, including methods for rendering, processing, and callback handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration info for the checkbox element, including processing and rendering callbacks.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Determines the value of the checkbox based on form input, handling checked and unchecked states.

methods.name: preRenderCheckbox
methods.description: Prepares the checkbox element for rendering in Twig, setting attributes and theme wrappers.

methods.name: processCheckbox
methods.description: Sets the '#checked' property of the checkbox based on submitted or default values.
